contract.title: TWIN-58 SoC AP ui_gateway与browser_hmi契约校验、显式动作解耦、离线状态同步与Batch AP-3中文注释补齐
contract.accepted_scope: Docker QA sandbox (deploy_twin.sh --build-only + CTest on build/ui_gateway + Python HMI contract & frontend 4-case G-code validation + per-file code_documentation_standard audit) verification of ISS-20261105-006 (/api/v1/state dynamic routing and static fake state cleanup), ISS-20261105-007 (saving slot config decoupled from LOAD/210°C), ISS-20261105-008 (two-stage model load vs start print), ISS-20261105-009 (G-code upload extension/empty/content 400 validation), ISS-20261105-010 (color weight sum and slot/action 400 validation), ISS-20261105-011 (UI bed out-of-range fault display), ISS-20261105-013 (offline OOBE and 4 filament sensors non-green state), ISS-20261105-017 (404 response buffer sizing without truncation), and Batch AP-3 Chinese code comments across ui_gateway + browser_hmi (20 files, ISS-20261105-018). Candidate commit c6692b244e0aa09d04e7051293f9fef3c67535dd is the consolidated soc-ap commit for the jointly approved batch TWIN-57/58/59 under APPR-20261105-004 (sibling paths in forward/device_manager and core/middleware/runtime belong to TWIN-57 and TWIN-59 in the same approved batch). Physical HIL verification is out of scope for this software sandbox task (covered by TWIN-55); all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

dependency_conditions.required: 继承TWIN-56 16-bit seq日志与三仓锁定基线

contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；自检单测与注释规范检查；独立沙箱与QA审查；收件
